postpartum and newborn visits start from the day of the birth","examples":"the example practice's own prices and lengths, not a standard","list":[{"name":"Meet the midwife (free consult)","price":"free","kind":"one price","length":"45 min","where":"at the birth center, or by video","before":"nothing taken","after":"nothing to pay","note":"questions, the practice's way of care, and whether a birth at the birth center or at home fits"},{"name":"Birth center care package","price":"$4,500 (example)","kind":"one price for the whole package","length":"about 30 weeks of care","where":"prenatal visits and the birth at the birth center; the first postpartum visits at home","before":"a $1,000 deposit when the care agreement is signed","after":"the rest is paid at the visits, never charged on its own on a set day","note":"covers the prenatal visits, being on call from 37 weeks, the birth with the midwife and a birth assistant, the newborn exams, the postpartum visits and the 6-week visit; a health plan is billed instead where the practice takes it"},{"name":"Home birth care package","price":"$5,500 (example)","kind":"one price for the whole package","length":"about 30 weeks of care","where":"prenatal visits at the client's home or at the office; only where the state's rules allow the midwife's kind to attend home births, and only inside the practice's travel area (a set drive time from the hospital)"},{"name":"Prenatal visit (in a package)","price":"uses one visit of the package","kind":"part of the package","length":"first visit 90 min; at the birth center at about 6 weeks","before":"nothing","after":"nothing more","note":"dates are set from the day of the birth"},{"name":"Well-person visit (yearly exam)","price":"$180 self-pay (example)","kind":"one price","length":"45 min","where":"at the office","before":"nothing taken","after":"the plan is billed; Rosie gives the number and books nothing for it","online":"a consult or a short prenatal check-in by video; it counts as at the office","nobodyHome":"never for a visit: the client must be there; a visit where nobody answers gets a safety check first (the welfare switch)","walkIns":"no walk-ins; a client in labor or with a worry uses the on-call line at any hour"}
pluginText.pf.questions: {"beforeTimes":["the client's first name","a new client or a current one","which visit: the practice's own visit types only, never a symptom typed into the AI","where the visit is: at the birth center, or at home (home visits only inside the practice's area)","a plan (its name only) or self-pay","for a video visit: which state the client will be in"],"afterTime":["anything the practice should know to help, like needing an interpreter","the client's name and mobile (for texts)"],"securePage":["the due date","how the person booking is related to the client, if someone else books","the plan's member ID, the plan holder and a photo of the plan card","the health history and the risk screen","the consents and the privacy notice","the care agreement (signed on the secure page)","who else may attend, with the client's signed OK","whether an interpreter is needed"],"whoMayBook":"the client, or a support person the client names on the secure page; a minor books her own care only where the owner's state form lets her consent alone, and until the form says so a parent or guardian books; a child under 13 never books, and nothing about them is kept","whoMayBring":"the client, or a support person the client names with a signed OK on the secure page; the practice may ask for a support person at a first visit, or where the state's rules require one","neverAsked":"symptoms, pregnancy weeks, tests, results or the birth plan are never asked or typed in the AI chat"}
pluginText.pf.safety: {"stop":[{"words":"heavy bleeding, a seizure, a bad headache with blurred vision, trouble breathing, chest pain, a fall or a car crash, or a newborn who isn't breathing","say":"Call 911 now. Rosie can't book care for an emergency. Then call the practice's on-call line: (555) 010-0188.","booking":"no booking; any visit stays booked"},{"words":"labor, your water breaking, or less baby movement","say":"Call the on-call midwife now: (555) 010-0188. If you can't reach her, or it's an emergency, call 911.","booking":"no booking; the on-call midwife answers at any hour, and Rosie books or moves nothing for it"},{"words":"thoughts of harming yourself or the baby, or a crisis after the birth","say":"Call or text 988 now. If you are in danger, call 911. Your midwife is told.","booking":"no booking; the same words in a later text get 988 again"},{"words":"swallowed medicine or a chemical","say":"Call Poison Help now at 1-800-222-1222. If the person isn't breathing or won't wake up, call 911.","booking":"no booking"}],"nurseLine":[{"words":"the practice's own list of signs for its on-call line (the example practice lists a fever in late pregnancy, and less movement)","say":"Please call the on-call line now: (555) 010-0188. If it's an emergency, call 911.","booking":"no booking by Rosie until the midwife has talked with the client"}],"goOn":[{"words":"a worry with nothing on the lists above","where":"matched to the practice's own visit: Rosie never judges how serious it is"}],"always":"the general screen: danger to life, fire, gas or a medical emergency gets 911, and words about self-harm get 988"}
pluginText.pf.first_steps: {"steps":[{"name":"Health history, risk screen, the consents and the care agreement","when":"on the secure page only, never by text; due before the first visit; one reminder before it's due","who":"every new client","result":"not done by its due date: the practice keeps the visit (signed on the secure page at the desk first), moves it, or cancels with no fee"},{"name":"The plan check","when":"while booking, by the front desk, by hand","who":"every client who names a plan","result":"covered, some services only, not covered, or can't check now (the desk checks later, and the client may cancel free)"},{"name":"A written price estimate for self-pay clients","when":"told while booking; sent within 1 business day, or sooner where the rules require it","who":"every client paying for themselves","result":"a to-do for the front desk, with its due date"},{"name":"A client's records from the last care provider","when":"asked for on the secure page; the practice gets them, office to office","who":"every new client","result":"a to-do for the front desk; the first visit goes ahead without them"},{"name":"The owner's OK for a new client","when":"before the first visit is booked","who":"every new client","result":"OK: booked; no: told kindly, nothing kept"}],"prep":"arrive 10 minutes early; bring the plan card, and the records you have from before; a support person comes only with the client's signed OK on the secure page; at home: a clear space for the midwife's supplies"}
pluginText.pf.visit: {"checkIn":"at the birth center: the check-in code at the front desk, and the desk checks the client is the one who booked; a video visit: the code read out at the start; at home: the code from the client at the door","beforeWork":"the midwife checks the blood pressure, weight and the changes since the last visit, before the exam","changes":"the midwife decides any test or shot from the client's record; a test is added only with the client's yes, with any self-pay price first; more care is booked as its own visit only if the client asks","done":"the check-in code or DONE; the visit notes, results and records stay in the practice's own chart, never in Rosie or a text; the next visit is booked at checkout","away":"at home: the midwife brings the birth supplies and a scale; a grown-up is there for the whole visit","childLeft":"never: the adult who brought the newborn stays for the whole visit"}
pluginText.pf.money: {"before":"nothing taken at booking for a visit the plan pays, and a free consult takes nothing; a care package takes its $1,000 deposit when the care agreement is signed, and the rest is paid at the visits (birth center) or on the bill after the birth (home birth), never charged on a set day by itself; a self-pay lactation visit or a class is paid in full when booking","plans":"the plans the practice takes (its own list); the front desk checks each plan by hand and records it; the share is an estimate, not a promise","selfPay":"a self-pay client is told while booking that they can get a written price estimate, and gets it on time; a bill far above it can be disputed (the federal rules set how)","vaccines":"none: no vaccine fees are taken through Rosie","fees":"no missed-visit fee by default; the owner may set one for self-pay visits only, never for a public-plan client","feeFree":"a switch: no fee ever for clients whose plan or the state's rules bar one, or whom the owner marks fee-free; their texts say 'No fee to cancel or miss'","after":"at the birth center: the rest is paid at the visit; at home: the bill comes after the birth; a plan's share is billed the practice's own way, and a balance after the plan pays is billed by the practice, not by Rosie's text","caps":"deposit cap: from the state form; fee limits for plan clients: from the plan's and the state's rules","rosfield":"the $2 per booking applies, as for every kind of work (D97): a flat fee for each booking Rosie's AI makes; no memberships are sold here","payOverTime":"none: no package is charged on set days by itself; the rest is paid at a visit or on a bill the client gets and pays","tips":"none","tax":"no tax line (the default)"}
pluginText.pf.messages: {"never":"texts carry only the practice's name, the date, the time, the address and a secure link: never the visit type, the pregnancy, symptoms, tests, results, the birth or the midwife's name at the birth center (at a home visit the midwife's name stays, for the door check)","staff":"texts to the owner and staff carry the client's initials, the time and a link; never the visit type or any health detail","languages":"English and Spanish; the secure page asks if the client needs an interpreter, and the practice is told","minors":"texts go to the client, or to the person the client names on the secure page; nothing about a newborn is texted to anyone but the parent or guardian","medical":"a medical question is never answered, saved or passed on: 911 if it's an emergency, then the on-call line or the practice's portal"}
pluginText.pf.staff: {"licenses":"each midwife's and birth assistant's own license or certificate, per state, if the owner adds it (optional; never checked by Rosie)","skills":"midwives: prenatal visits, the birth at the birth center or at home (where the state's rules allow), postpartum and newborn visits, and well-person visits (nurse-midwives); birth assistants: births and postpartum visits with a midwife; the lactation consultant: breastfeeding help; only people the owner clears go to homes","supervision":"a midwife who isn't yet fully licensed works under the state's rules for supervision or a collaboration agreement (the owner's form sets it)","oks":"the owner OKs a new client's first visit, and any visit a midwife flags","standIn":"a midwife out: the backup midwife the client has met may take the visit, with the client's yes; nobody is moved without it","away":"the home team is the people the owner clears for home visits, with a scale and the birth supplies"}
pluginText.pf.rules: {"records":"the practice keeps a client's chart as long as the state's rules require; a delete request removes only Rosie's own booking details, never the chart","copies":"a client's copy of the records within the time the rules set; Rosie sends only booking and payment records","showLicense":"any license the owner adds is shown where the owner says so; Rosie shows nothing as checked","minors":"who may consent for a minor, from the state's form (the owner's setting)","custody":"a court order or custody limit the practice holds is kept on its record, and Rosie follows the record, not the caller's word alone","language":"free language help where the rules require it","host":"none: no school or group hosting","ads":"no free-visit or price claims the state's rules don't allow","privacy":"health privacy rules for every message and form","papers":"the birth certificate and newborn screening papers are the practice's own job, filed in the state's time; Rosie doesn't file them or track their dates"}
pluginText.pf.edges: {"lateArrival":"up to 15 minutes late: still seen; later, the desk may offer a new time (the practice decides; Rosie never changes the booking itself)","officeLate":"when the practice runs late, a new time costs nothing","standIn":"a midwife out: the backup midwife the client has met, with the client's yes, or new times with no fee","forms":"a form not done by its due date: one reminder, then the practice keeps the visit (signed on the secure page first), moves it, or cancels with no fee","planChange":"the plan check comes back not covered: self-pay with a written estimate, or a free cancel","twoBookings":"a client with visits open for two people: Rosie asks which one before any change","worse":"a client worried before a visit: the 911 or on-call words if they match; Rosie never judges how serious it is, and the visit stays booked","healthQuestion":"a question about medicine or care before a visit: never answered by Rosie; 911 if it's an emergency, then the on-call line or the portal","siblings":"a second person added to a booking (a partner at a class) gets their own seat","newborn":"a home visit that can't happen as booked: the soonest open window comes first, with no fee, and the on-call line is named in the text","urgent":"no service is sent now through Rosie: a birth is on call (the on-call line in pf.safety), and a client with a worry gets the soonest visit","other":"all other edge cases the generic way"}

Means '2 No license: registration only': the business holds none, or only a practice registration.
